function getParameterByName(name, url) {
		if(url == null){
		  url = window.location.href;
		}
	    name = name.replace(/[\[\]]/g, '\\$&');
	    var regex = new RegExp('[?&]' + name + '(=([^&#]*)|&|#|$)'),
		results = regex.exec(url);
	    if (!results) return null;
	    if (!results[2]) return '';
	    return decodeURIComponent(results[2].replace(/\+/g, ' '));
	}

    var STYLE_ID = 'at-body-style';
    function getParent() {
    return doc.getElementsByTagName('head')[0];
    }
    function addStyle(parent, id, def) {
        if (!parent) {
        return;
        }
        var style = doc.createElement('style');
        style.id = id;
        style.innerHTML = def;
        parent.appendChild(style);
    }
    function removeStyle(parent, id) {
        if (!parent) {
            return;
        }
        var style = doc.getElementById(id);
        if (!style) {
            return;
        }
        parent.removeChild(style);
    }
    addStyle(getParent(), STYLE_ID, style);
    setTimeout(function() {
    removeStyle(getParent(), STYLE_ID);
    }, timeout);

    /**
 * String.prototype.replaceAll() polyfill
 * https://gomakethings.com/how-to-replace-a-section-of-a-string-with-another-one-with-vanilla-js/
 * @author Chris Ferdinandi
 * @license MIT
 */
if (!String.prototype.replaceAll) {
	String.prototype.replaceAll = function(str, newStr){
		// If a regex pattern
		if (Object.prototype.toString.call(str).toLowerCase() === '[object regexp]') {
			return this.replace(str, newStr);
		}
		// If a string
		return this.replace(new RegExp(str, 'g'), newStr);
	};

	function getCookie(cname) {
	 	var name = cname + "=";
  		var decodedCookie = decodeURIComponent(document.cookie);
		var ca = decodedCookie.split(';');
  		for(var i = 0; i <ca.length; i++) {
    			var c = ca[i];
    			while (c.charAt(0) == ' ') {
     				 c = c.substring(1);
    			}
    			if (c.indexOf(name) == 0) {
    				 return c.substring(name.length, c.length);
    			}
  		}
  		return "";
	}

function addStyle(styles) {            
    /* Create style document */
    var css = document.createElement('style');
    css.type = 'text/css';

    if (css.styleSheet) 
        css.styleSheet.cssText = styles;
    else 
        css.appendChild(document.createTextNode(styles));

    /* Append style to the tag name */
    document.getElementsByTagName("head")[0].appendChild(css);
}
function httpGet(theUrl,req_type) {
    if (window.XMLHttpRequest) { // code for IE7+, Firefox, Chrome, Opera, Safari
        xmlhttp=new XMLHttpRequest();
    } else {// code for IE6, IE5
        xmlhttp=new ActiveXObject("Microsoft.XMLHTTP");
    }
    xmlhttp.onreadystatechange=function()
    {
        if (xmlhttp.readyState==4 && xmlhttp.status==200)
        {
            if(req_type == 'menu_html'){
            var nav_text = xmlhttp.responseText.replaceAll('https://static.cloud.coveo.com/searchui/v2.9159/js/CoveoJsSearch.Lazy.min.js', '');
            nav_text = nav_text.replaceAll('src="/', 'src="'+maindomain_lang+'/');
            nav_text = nav_text.replaceAll("src='/", "src='"+maindomain_lang+"/");
            nav_text = nav_text.replaceAll("'/content", "'"+maindomain_lang+"/content");
                        
            document.getElementById("PAN_2021_NAV_ASYNC").innerHTML = nav_text.replaceAll('href="/', 'href="'+maindomain_lang+'/');

            var lozad_back = document.getElementsByClassName('lozad-background');
            Array.prototype.forEach.call(lozad_back, function(el) {
            // Do stuff here
            var el_back_img_path = el.getAttribute('data-background-image');
            var first_pos = el_back_img_path.indexOf("'");
            var last_pos = el_back_img_path.indexOf("'",first_pos+1);
            el_back_img_path = el_back_img_path.substring(first_pos+1,last_pos);
            let result = el_back_img_path.includes(main_site_url);
            if(result == false){
                el.setAttribute("data-background-image",main_site_url+el_back_img_path);
            }
            else{
                el.setAttribute("data-background-image",el_back_img_path);
            }
            });
            const observer_lozad = lozad('.lozad, .lozad-background'); // lazy loads elements with default selector as '.lozad'
            observer_lozad.observe();
            }
            if(req_type == 'head_inline_css'){
            addStyle(xmlhttp.responseText);
            }
        }
    }
    xmlhttp.open("GET", theUrl, true );
    xmlhttp.send();    
}

                <h2><a id="post-189953-_n41yi9jwwr88"></a>Executive Summary</h2>
<p>Unit 42 has tracked and responded to numerous waves of vishing attacks conducted by Com-affiliated threat actors in recent months. The attacks have led to data theft and extortion attempts. This activity has targeted data-rich industries, such as financial services, healthcare and legal services. Targeted organizations were primarily located in the U.S., UK and Australia.</p>
<p>Attribution for this broad activity includes:</p>
<ul>
<li>Named actors such as <a href="https://unit42.paloaltonetworks.com/tag/bling-libra/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Bling Libra (aka ShinyHunters)</a></li>
<li>Activity clusters <a href="https://rhisac.org/threat-intelligence/extortion-in-the-enterprise-defending-against-blackfile-attacks/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">CL-CRI-1116 (aka Redact, formerly BlackFile)</a>, <a href="https://github.com/PaloAltoNetworks/Unit42-timely-threat-intel/blob/main/2026-06-03-Pink-Extortion-Brand-Activity.txt?utm_campaign=tti_pinkextortion" target="_blank" rel="noopener">CL-CRI-1147 (aka Pink)</a>, <a href="https://github.com/PaloAltoNetworks/Unit42-timely-threat-intel/blob/main/2026-07-15-CL-CRI-1182-activity.txt" target="_blank" rel="noopener">CL-CRI-1182 (aka Falcon)</a>, CL-CRI-1192 (aka Helix)</li>
<li>The newly uncovered CL-CRI-1264 (aka Vortex) and CL-CRI-1274 (aka Cinder), which overlap with activity Google tracks as UNC6671</li>
</ul>
<p>This article details:</p>
<ul>
<li>Our observations of persistent Com-affiliated threat activity since August 2026 based on unique telemetry analysis and incident response engagements</li>
<li>The different named actors and activity clusters we track, including unique observations not previously disclosed</li>
<li>Insights on victimology</li>
<li>Review of attacker tactics, techniques and procedures (TTPs)</li>
<li>Allusions to future activity as we head into 2027</li>
</ul>
<p>Palo Alto Networks customers are better protected from the threats discussed above through the following products and services:</p>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://docs.paloaltonetworks.com/wildfire" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Advanced WildFire</a></li>
<li><a href="https://docs.paloaltonetworks.com/advanced-url-filtering" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Advanced URL Filtering</a>, <a href="https://docs.paloaltonetworks.com/dns-security" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Advanced DNS Security</a> and <a href="https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/network-security/advanced-ip-defense" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Advanced IP Defense</a></li>
<li><a href="https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/cortex/cortex-xdr" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Cortex XDR</a> and<a href="https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/resources/datasheets/cortex-xsiam-aag" target="_blank" rel="noopener"> XSIAM</a></li>
<li><a href="https://www.koi.ai/product/endpoint" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Cortex Agentic Endpoint Security</a></li>
<li><a href="https://docs.paloaltonetworks.com/prisma-access-browser" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Prisma Browser </a></li>
<li><a href="https://docs.paloaltonetworks.com/iot/getting-started/iot-security-solution" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Device Security</a></li>
<li><a href="https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/idira/human/identity-and-access-management" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Idira Identity and Access Management (IAM)</a></li>
<li><a href="https://docs.cyberark.com/detect-and-respond/latest/en/content/get-started/what-is-detect-and-respond.htm" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Idira Identity Threat Detection and Response (ITDR) </a></li>
<li><a href="https://docs.cyberark.com/manage/latest/en/content/sws/getstarted/sws-introduction-2.htm" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Idira Secure Web Sessions (SWS)</a></li>
</ul>
<p>Organizations can access tailored adversary intelligence, direct analyst consultations, and specialized exposure tracking through<a href="https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/unit42/threat-intelligence"> Unit 42 Threat Intel Services</a> and its<a href="https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/resources/datasheets/unit-42-deep-and-dark-web-service"> Deep and Dark Web Service</a>.</p>
<p>If you think you might have been compromised or have an urgent matter, contact the <a href="https://start.paloaltonetworks.com/contact-unit42.html" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Unit 42 Incident Response team</a>.</p>

<h2><a id="post-189953-_pwgqqy1386js"></a>Background</h2>
<p>Since early 2026, we have responded to numerous data theft and extortion attempts that we have attributed to Bling Libra and other Com-affiliated threat actors. More details on the typical playbook used by the attackers can be found in the <a href="#post-189953-_i1krwwlb02i5">Tactics, Techniques and Procedures section</a> of this article.</p>
<p>We track these activities using the threat group and activity cluster naming conventions, which are noted in Table 1.</p>

<h2><a id="post-189953-_2fps6z7brbrt"></a>Latest Insights</h2>
<h3><a id="post-189953-_6o7n52mol525"></a>Emerging Activity Cluster CL-CRI-1264 (Vortex)</h3>
<p>In September 2026, we identified a new activity cluster that we track as CL-CRI-1264. The tradecraft used by the attackers largely follows the wider playbook used by Com-affiliated threat actors, but a few traits set it apart. Most notably, we observed this activity primarily targeting healthcare, pharmaceutical and other medical organizations.</p>
<p>Attackers associated with CL-CRI-1264 establish initial access through vishing, where they pose as internal IT support and direct employees to servers using subdomains tailored to each targeted organization. These servers act as adversary-in-the-middle (AiTM) proxies that pass user credentials and multi-factor authentication (MFA) approvals to the attackers in real time. Attackers have targeted employees on both their corporate workstations and personal mobile devices.</p>
<p>We have observed attackers behind CL-CRI-1264 enrolling an unauthorized MFA device within minutes of authenticating to establish persistence. In multiple instances, the attackers have reused a single device named <span style="font-family: 'courier new', courier, monospace;">Pixel 10a</span> across compromised accounts. They have also automated data exfiltration using Python scripts (<span style="font-family: 'courier new', courier, monospace;">python-httpx</span> User Agent) to target Microsoft 365 mailbox, OneDrive and SharePoint content.</p>
<p>Following exfiltration, the attackers have sent Microsoft Teams messages directly to employees at victim organizations, claiming data theft and directing recipients to a Tor-hosted negotiation site.</p>
<h3><a id="post-189953-_obvrwxluovis"></a>Emerging Activity Cluster CL-CRI-1274 (Cinder)</h3>
<p>In September 2026, we identified another new activity cluster that we track as CL-CRI-1274. Similar to other activity detailed throughout this report, the attackers used vishing for initial access and avoided re-prompting for Duo MFA by replaying a persistent “keep me signed in” session token. They then replayed that same session token from proxy infrastructure.</p>
<p>From there, they used scripted access through python-requests (<span style="font-family: 'courier new', courier, monospace;">python-requests/2.34.2</span>) and the Microsoft Graph software development kit (SDK) to collect and exfiltrate data from the victim’s SharePoint and OneDrive environments. Afterwards, the attackers used a compromised account to send extortion messages internally via email and Microsoft Teams, ultimately directing recipients to a Tor-hosted negotiation site.</p>
<h3><a id="post-189953-_lgaczpy4tquz"></a>Malicious Browser Extension</h3>
<p>During an investigation attributed to another activity cluster, CL-CRI-1192 (which Google tracks under UNC6671), we identified a <a href="https://www.virustotal.com/gui/file/ea8d30c42e758559e78bd1fe97f8849011beb7f24c7f092a066a5a62fa7fbe6f" target="_blank" rel="noopener">malicious browser extension</a> (manifest version 1.6.111) named Google Chrome.</p>
<p>The extension was not on the Chrome Web Store. It was downloaded from an attacker-controlled server at <span style="font-family: 'courier new', courier, monospace;">oskeysetup[.]com</span> and required the victim to manually sideload it using Developer Mode. Naming the extension <span style="font-family: 'courier new', courier, monospace;">Google Chrome</span> helps disguise the browser's built-in warning banner (<span style="font-family: 'courier new', courier, monospace;">Google Chrome started debugging this browser</span>) when the extension is active.</p>
<p>This domain's registration information closely resembles attacker infrastructure previously disclosed by <a href="https://cloud.google.com/blog/topics/threat-intelligence/unc6671-targets-financial-services-and-enterprise-cloud-environments" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Google</a> and <a href="https://reliaquest.com/blog/threat-spotlight-helix-new-name-in-data-extortion-ecosystem/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">ReliaQuest</a> in relation to the activity that we track as CL-CRI-1192.</p>
<p>This browser extension performs several malicious actions:</p>
<ul>
<li>Installs global keyloggers</li>
<li>Steals local/session storage and <span style="font-family: 'courier new', courier, monospace;">IndexedDB</span> data across all sites</li>
<li>Harvests authentication cookies (targeting Microsoft and Google accounts)</li>
<li>Scans pages for QR codes to capture login/MFA tokens</li>
<li>Streams webcam feeds</li>
</ul>
<p>Furthermore, this browser extension implements a full command-and-control (C2) remote control module via Chrome DevTools Protocol (<span style="font-family: 'courier new', courier, monospace;">chrome.debugger</span>). It allows operators to perform the following activities:</p>
<ul>
<li>Capture hidden screenshots</li>
<li>Dispatch input events</li>
<li>Steal clipboard contents</li>
<li>Allow remote site navigation</li>
</ul>
<p>We pivoted on this file and identified <a href="https://www.virustotal.com/gui/file/930898e8b65e9cf4e2595ac4092042a707cca8922751e723ad8b86260655154a" target="_blank" rel="noopener">an additional browser extension</a> also masquerading as Google Chrome (version 1.6.112) that communicates with the same C2 server. Both files share the same hard-coded API key.</p>
<p>We assess with moderate confidence that the attackers associated with CL-CRI-1192 developed this malicious browser extension as an alternative method to extract credentials from desktop and laptop devices running Chromium-based browsers such as Google Chrome and Microsoft Edge. The extension might also be shared with and used by other Com-affiliated attackers, although we currently have no evidence to suggest this.</p>
<p>We recognize Kevin Pham for his detailed investigation into this browser extension in a <a href="https://deoxy.net/blog/inside-unc6671s-browser-implant/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">September 2026 write-up</a>.</p>
<h2><a id="post-189953-_hfxjfqaiydhc"></a>Victimology</h2>
<p>Our telemetry shows sustained campaigns by Com-affiliated threat actors accelerating significantly around August 2026. The victims share a common profile: they hold large volumes of high-impact corporate data where exposure carries severe regulatory, legal or market consequences. Financial services, healthcare and legal organizations were primary targets, though activity spans across other industries.</p>
<p>Rather than targeting generic mailboxes, actors systematically sought individuals or systems responsible for high-value files, documents and databases. These attacks focused on:</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Legal and corporate strategy: </strong>Actors targeted partner communications, firm strategy, executive compensation and pending contracts. They explicitly threatened to publish client agreements and confidential casework.</li>
<li><strong>Financial and investment records: </strong>Attackers prioritized private investment portfolios, deal pipelines and large-scale cloud data warehouses. They occasionally exfiltrated tens of millions of customer relationship management (CRM) and recruiting records.</li>
<li><strong>Healthcare and life sciences: </strong>Attackers targeted cloud data platforms containing patient records and proprietary research. To maximize pressure, actors broadcast extortion notices across internal chat channels and threatened regulatory reporting.</li>
</ul>
<p>The most targeted organizations have distributed workforces, centralized single sign-on (SSO) and extensive cloud collaboration platforms. They are also predominantly based in English-speaking countries. We have observed actors repeatedly targeting the same organization, sometimes returning weeks after a failed attempt.</p>
<h3><a id="post-189953-_8nwm3o6mi0ji"></a>Who Is Being Targeted: Industries and Countries</h3>
<p>Our monitoring of domains linked to Com-related activity showed that their targeting shifted from financial services to healthcare in early September 2026. Figure 1 shows that these attackers targeted financial services organizations about twice as often as healthcare organizations in August 2026, but healthcare overtook financial services in September, around when we first observed CL-CRI-1264 activity. Healthcare continued to be the most targeted industry in October 2026, alongside financial services. Attackers also frequently targeted construction, high technology and transportation and logistics organizations.</p>
<figure id="attachment_189954" aria-describedby="caption-attachment-189954" style="width: 1000px" class="wp-caption alignnone"><img  class="wp-image-189954 lozad"  data-src="https://unit42.paloaltonetworks.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/word-image-664521-189953-1.png" alt="Line chart showing the number of cyberattacks on various industries over time. Industries include Healthcare, Financial Services, Construction, High Technology, Transportation &amp; Logistics, Professional &amp; Legal Services, Manufacturing, Pharma &amp; Life Sciences, Insurance, Real Estate. Lines fluctuate with spikes visible around early to mid-September. The horizontal axis represents dates, and the vertical axis shows the number of cyberattacks." width="1000" height="556" data-srcset="https://unit42.paloaltonetworks.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/word-image-664521-189953-1.png 1600w, https://unit42.paloaltonetworks.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/word-image-664521-189953-1-786x437.png 786w, https://unit42.paloaltonetworks.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/word-image-664521-189953-1-1260x700.png 1260w, https://unit42.paloaltonetworks.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/word-image-664521-189953-1-768x427.png 768w, https://unit42.paloaltonetworks.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/word-image-664521-189953-1-1536x853.png 1536w" sizes="(max-width: 1000px) 100vw, 1000px" /><figcaption id="caption-attachment-189954" class="wp-caption-text">Figure 1. Industries of organizations targeted in subdomains between August and October 2026.</figcaption></figure>
<p>Figure 2 shows that between August and October 2026, most targeted organizations were based in the U.S. However, we observed increased targeting of Australian organizations beginning in late September 2026. Australian organizations made up less than 1% of observed subdomains in August and September, rising to about 13% in October. Organizations in Australia are now the second most targeted.</p>
<figure id="attachment_189965" aria-describedby="caption-attachment-189965" style="width: 1000px" class="wp-caption alignnone"><img  class="wp-image-189965 lozad"  data-src="https://unit42.paloaltonetworks.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/word-image-667339-189953-2.png" alt="Bar chart titled &quot;Top Targeted Geographies by Percentage Share (Aug - Oct 2026)&quot; with data for three months: August, September, October. Each bar is divided by country. United States leads with 95.3% in August, 91.9% in September, and 76.2% in October. Other countries include Australia, United Kingdom, Canada, Switzerland, and an &quot;Other&quot; category. Australia's share increases to 13.0% in October." width="1000" height="650" data-srcset="https://unit42.paloaltonetworks.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/word-image-667339-189953-2.png 1600w, https://unit42.paloaltonetworks.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/word-image-667339-189953-2-677x440.png 677w, https://unit42.paloaltonetworks.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/word-image-667339-189953-2-1077x700.png 1077w, https://unit42.paloaltonetworks.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/word-image-667339-189953-2-768x499.png 768w, https://unit42.paloaltonetworks.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/word-image-667339-189953-2-1536x998.png 1536w" sizes="(max-width: 1000px) 100vw, 1000px" /><figcaption id="caption-attachment-189965" class="wp-caption-text">Figure 2. Countries of organizations targeted in subdomains between August and October 2026.</figcaption></figure>
<h2><a id="post-189953-_i1krwwlb02i5"></a>Tactics, Techniques and Procedures</h2>
<h3><a id="post-189953-_2xnixfo7446x"></a>Infrastructure and Tooling</h3>
<p>A key characteristic of Com-affiliated threat actors is their use of apex domains that pose as SSO portals, IT support pages and passkey configuration services. These domains often host short-lived subdomains that impersonate target organizations, such as <span style="font-family: 'courier new', courier, monospace;">{company}.mfaregister[.]com</span>. We actively track this infrastructure, conduct threat hunting for identified domains and publish key findings as Timely Threat Intelligence (TTI) in our <a href="https://github.com/PaloAltoNetworks/Unit42-timely-threat-intel/tree/main" target="_blank" rel="noopener">GitHub repository</a>.</p>
<p>Across Com-affiliated cases, we have identified similarities in hosting infrastructure, attack chains and victimology. In some cases, these actors also share tooling, such as Doko's Panel, an operator-controlled AiTM phishing kit.</p>
<p>As previously reported by <a href="https://pushsecurity.com/blog/inside-criminal-phishing-panel" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Push Security</a>, some Okta-targeting variants of the kit replace the panel's default <span style="font-family: 'courier new', courier, monospace;">backend.php</span> handler with the renamed endpoint <span style="font-family: 'courier new', courier, monospace;">api_FyekIDWY.php</span>. We observed this endpoint on multiple domains associated with Com-affiliated cases.</p>
<p>In at least one financial services case, telemetry recorded a full AiTM sequence from credential entry to an MFA number-match prompt, indicating a likely successful session capture, as shown in Figure 3.</p>
<figure id="attachment_189976" aria-describedby="caption-attachment-189976" style="width: 780px" class="wp-caption alignnone"><img  class="wp-image-189976 lozad"  data-src="https://unit42.paloaltonetworks.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/word-image-670220-189953-3.png" alt="Diagram showing credential and MFA capture process. It involves three entities: Victim, Adversary-in-the-middle proxy, and Operator. The sequences include steps like landing page lure, phishing kit activation, username submission, password submission, and MFA challenges. Final step shows authenticated session relayed to the operator. The process uses Cloudflare-fronted phishing kit and mentions Evilginx2 kit and Dokis Panel as components." width="780" height="664" data-srcset="https://unit42.paloaltonetworks.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/word-image-670220-189953-3.png 780w, https://unit42.paloaltonetworks.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/word-image-670220-189953-3-517x440.png 517w, https://unit42.paloaltonetworks.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/word-image-670220-189953-3-768x654.png 768w" sizes="(max-width: 780px) 100vw, 780px" /><figcaption id="caption-attachment-189976" class="wp-caption-text">Figure 3. Flow chart describing an observed attack.</figcaption></figure>
<p>Domains consistent with Com-affiliated infrastructure have also been observed in campaigns that use different techniques to target victims. For example, <a href="https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/security/blog/2026/09/09/passkey-themed-social-engineering-leads-identity-cloud-compromise/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Microsoft</a> reported <span style="font-family: 'courier new', courier, monospace;">oskeyregister[.]com</span> in its research into passkey-themed social engineering.</p>
<p>Building on this reporting, we identified Cloudflare Pages URLs following the pattern <span style="font-family: 'courier new', courier, monospace;">connect-pages-{company}.pages[.]dev</span> that redirect to company-specific subdomains such as <span style="font-family: 'courier new', courier, monospace;">{company}.oskeyregister[.]com</span>. These findings reflect the broader Com ecosystem, which comprises several activity clusters that frequently share infrastructure but can vary slightly in their tradecraft.</p>
<p>Beyond shared infrastructure, recurring patterns in the registration and deployment of tooling associated with Com-affiliated threat actors provide additional opportunities to identify related domains. Table 2 shows common registration patterns observed across this activity.</p>

<h3><a id="post-189953-_r08aol57kfka"></a><strong>Attacker Playbook</strong></h3>
<p>We did not observe a standard playbook employed by Com-affiliated threat actors. Rather than employing custom tools, the threat actors primarily leveraged native cloud utilities and selectively limited executions and persistence deployments.</p>
<p>Intrusions typically begin with vishing, in which threat actors pose as IT staff resolving an authentication issue and direct the victim to a phishing page tailored to their organization. After the AiTM kit captures credentials and session tokens, the attackers quickly enroll their own MFA devices, misuse cloud utilities and, in some cases, deploy malicious browser extensions to exfiltrate data and extort victims.</p>
<p>Using the harvested authentication data, Com-affiliated threat actors authenticate to victim environments, typically routing through residential proxy networks and commercial VPNs. They then seek to establish multi-layered persistence, enumerate sensitive data and exfiltrate data from cloud platforms. We observed the following techniques across Com-affiliated threat actors:</p>
<p><strong>Persistence</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Enrolling unauthorized MFA devices and workstation objects</li>
<li>Generating cloud infrastructure temporary credentials</li>
<li>Authorizing unapproved third-party OAuth applications or data-sync utilities</li>
<li>Staging secondary accounts or harvesting redundant credentials</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Discovery and Defense Evasion</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Monitoring authentications, permissions and mailboxes</li>
<li>Modifying calendar settings and mailbox rules</li>
<li>Clearing security alert events</li>
<li>Rotating infrastructure</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Exfiltration</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Using open-source tools such as Rclone and cloud storage platforms</li>
<li>Exfiltrating via native SaaS and REST APIs or scripted HTTP-based exfiltration</li>
<li>Moving data via SaaS to SaaS transfers</li>
</ul>
<h2><a id="post-189953-_rt54on20d5fv"></a>Conclusion</h2>
<p>Earlier this year, our <a href="https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/resources/research/unit-42-incident-response-report" target="_blank" rel="noopener">2026 Unit 42 Global Incident Response Report</a> found that extortion incidents in 2025 not using encryption (at 78%) dropped below the 90% range for the first time in several years. This trend has continued into 2026 and we don’t expect a slowdown. Cybercriminals like Bling Libra and other Com-affiliated threat actors are pivoting away from encryption, enabling them to move at greater speed across their intrusion lifecycle while still achieving their objectives.</p>
<p>Another plausible motivation for the shift away from using encryption is to fly below the radar of law enforcement officials, given their crackdown on ransomware operators in recent years. However, shifting away from using encryption no longer seems to be enough to keep them under the radar. This is based on the reported arrests of suspected Bling Libra members such as “<a href="https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/key-shinyhunters-hacker-detained-jordan-is-cooperating-sources-say-2026-10-03/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Rey</a>” and “<a href="https://krebsonsecurity.com/2026/09/dutch-police-arrest-reformed-hacker-in-shiny-hunters-investigation/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Umbreon</a>” that occurred in proximity to the group’s claims of a breach of the <a href="https://x.com/FBI/status/2102807819695071709" target="_blank" rel="noopener">FBI</a>.</p>
<p>Recent arrests also include a <a href="https://krebsonsecurity.com/2026/10/feds-suspect-ransom-negotiator-ran-shinyhunters-extortion-site/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">person who allegedly ran Bling Libra’s extortion site</a>.</p>
<p>Going forward, organizations must:</p>
<ul>
<li>Tighten help desk verification processes</li>
<li>Transition to phishing-resistant MFA (FIDO2/passkeys)</li>
<li>Implement browser extension allowlists</li>
<li>Establish visibility into identity actions</li>
<li>Alert on unauthorized data exports to mitigate the threat activity described in this article</li>
</ul>

<ul>

<script>
 var PAN_LOAD_RECAPTCHA_LANGUAGE = 'en_US';

(function($) {
	// Migrated from the unit42-v5 + Modifications
	var subscribeSuccess = false;
	var email = document.getElementById('newsletter-email');
	var subscription_form = document.getElementById('unit42footerSubscription_form');
	var subscription_form_button = document.getElementById('unit42footerSubscription_form_button');
        var isCaptchaComplete02  = false;	
        window.captchaInlineFormOnload = function(token){
            isCaptchaComplete02 = true;
            $("form[name='Unit42_Subscribe'] button[id='unit42footerSubscription_form_button']").prop('disabled', false);
        }
        var PAN_INLINE_FORM_RECAPTCHA_LOADED = false;
        const SITE_KEY = '6LdDKhIsAAAAABdoYV3PR5VJ2Gz23_dLSvq2uvBQ'; 
                if(!PAN_INLINE_FORM_RECAPTCHA_LOADED){
               PAN_INLINE_FORM_RECAPTCHA_LOADED = true;
               // trigger loading api.js (recaptcha.js) script
               var recapthaScript = $("script[src='https://www.google.com/recaptcha/enterprise.js?render="+SITE_KEY+"&hl="+PAN_LOAD_RECAPTCHA_LANGUAGE+"&onload=captchaInlineFormOnload']").length
               // console.log("recapthaScript",recapthaScript);
               if (!recapthaScript) {
                   var head = document.getElementsByTagName('head')[0];
                   var script = document.createElement('script');
                   script.typerecapthaScript = 'text/javascript';
                   script.src = "https://www.google.com/recaptcha/enterprise.js?render="+SITE_KEY+"&hl="+PAN_LOAD_RECAPTCHA_LANGUAGE+"&onload=captchaInlineFormOnload";
                   head.appendChild(script);
               }
               else{
                   captchaInlineFormOnload();
                }
           }
            	
	
	$(subscription_form).submit(function(e) {
		e.preventDefault();
		e.stopImmediatePropagation();
		updateEmailMask();
		var success = true;
		var form = $(this);
		var mail = form.find('input[name="Email"]');
		
		if (mail.val() === '') {
			mail.addClass('has-error');
			showError(1);
			success = false;	
		}  else if (!isEmail(mail.val())){
			showError(2);
			success = false;
		}
		else {
			mail.removeClass('has-error');
			$('.error-mail').addClass('d-none');
		}

		

		if (success) {
                                                if(grecaptcha){
                        grecaptcha.enterprise.ready(function() {
                            grecaptcha.enterprise.execute(SITE_KEY, {action: 'submit'}).then(function(token) {
                                submitSubscribeForm({token :token, action : 'submit'},form);
                            });
                        });
                    }
                    			
		}
		return false;
	});
        function submitSubscribeForm(tokenData, form){
            var serialized_data = form.serialize();
            let captchaParams = `&g-recaptcha-response=${tokenData.token}&action=${tokenData.action}`;
            $.ajax({
				type: 'POST',
				url: form.attr('action'),
				data: serialized_data+captchaParams,
				beforeSend: function() {
                 form.find('button').addClass('is-loading');
    			},
				success: function(msg) {
					form.find('.form-success-message').html('<p class="success-message">You have been successfully subscribed</p>');
					form.find('button').removeClass('is-loading');
					$(email).val('');
					clearError();
				},
				error: function(jqXHR, textStatus, errorThrown) {
					$(subscription_form_button).addClass('is-disabled', true);
					form.find('button').removeClass('is-loading');
					
				}
			});
            
        }
	function showError(error_type){
		if(error_type == 1) {
			$('.error-mail').text("Please enter the email address.").addClass('error-show');
			$(subscription_form_button).addClass('is-disabled');
		} else if(error_type == 2){
			$('.error-mail').text("Please provide a valid e-mail address.").addClass('error-show');
			$(subscription_form_button).addClass('is-disabled');
		}	
		$(subscription_form_button).removeClass('is-loading');
	}
	function clearError(){
		$('.error-mail').text("").removeClass('error-show');;
		$(subscription_form_button).removeClass('is-loading');
		$(subscription_form_button).removeClass('is-disabled');
	}
	
	$(email).on('input', function (event) { 
		var email = $(this).val();
		if (isEmail(email) ) {			
			clearError();
		} else if(email == ""){
			clearError();
		} else{
			showError(2);			  
		}
    });

	function isEmail(email) {
		var re = /^(([^<>()\[\]\\.,;:\s@"]+(\.[^<>()\[\]\\.,;:\s@"]+)*)|(".+"))@((\[[0-9]{1,3}\.[0-9]{1,3}\.[0-9]{1,3}\.[0-9]{1,3}\])|(([a-zA-Z\-0-9]+\.)+[a-zA-Z]{2,}))$/;
		return re.test(String(email).toLowerCase());
	}
	
	
	
	function updateEmailMask() {
		var email = $("#unit42footerSubscription_form input[name='Email']").val();
		if (email && email.trim() != '') {
			var maskedEmail = maskEmailAddress(email);
			$("#unit42footerSubscription_form input[name='emailFormMask']").val(maskedEmail);
		}
	}

	function maskEmailAddress (emailAddress) {
		function mask(str) {
			var strLen = str.length;
			if (strLen > 4) {
				return str.substr(0, 1) + str.substr(1, strLen - 1).replace(/\w/g, '*') + str.substr(-1,1);
			}
			return str.replace(/\w/g, '*');
		}
		return emailAddress.replace(/([\w.]+)@([\w.]+)(\.[\w.]+)/g, function (m, p1, p2, p3) {
			return mask(p1) + '@' + mask(p2) + p3;
		});

		return emailAddress;
	}

}(jQuery));
//# sourceMappingURL=main.js.map
	
</script>

	.newsletter .checkbox-wrapper .form-check-label{
		color:#FFFFFF;
	}
</style>
<script type="text/javascript">
	$(document).ready(function(){
		$("html").on("click", ".language-btn", function () {
			$(this).toggleClass("expand");
			$(".language-dropdown").toggleClass("expand");
		});

		$("html").on("click", "body", function (b) {
			if (!$(b.target).is(".language-btn")) {
				$(".language-btn").removeClass("expand");
				$(".language-dropdown").removeClass("expand");
			}
		});
	});
</script>

}

function loadScript(url, defer){
    var script1 = document.createElement('script');
    script1.setAttribute('type', 'text/javascript');
    script1.setAttribute('src',url);
    if(defer == true){
        script1.setAttribute('defer','defer');
    }
    document.head.appendChild(script1);
}
function loadScript1(url, callback){

    var script = document.createElement("script")
    script.type = "text/javascript";
    if (script.readyState){  //IE
        script.onreadystatechange = function(){
            if (script.readyState == "loaded" || script.readyState == "complete"){
                script.onreadystatechange = null;
                callback();
            }
        };
    } else {  //Others
        script.onload = function(){
            callback();
        };
    }
    script.src = url;
    document.getElementsByTagName("head")[0].appendChild(script);
}

          }, 3000);

document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
  // Find all the forms on the page
  var forms = document.getElementsByTagName("form");

  // Loop through each form
  for (var i = 0; i < forms.length; i++) {
    var form = forms[i];

    // Check if the hidden input field already exists
    var requestInput = form.querySelector("input[name='web_unit42_req_id']");
    if (!requestInput) {
      // Create a hidden input element if it doesn't exist
      requestInput = document.createElement("input");
      requestInput.type = "hidden";
      requestInput.name = "web_unit42_req_id";
      requestInput.id = "web_unit42_req_id";

      // Append the hidden field to the form
      form.appendChild(requestInput);
    }
  }
});

// Assign the onCheqResponse function to the window object to handle events from any form
window.onCheqResponse = function(encryptedMessage, requestID) {
  // Find all the forms on the page
  var forms = document.getElementsByTagName("form");

  for (var i = 0; i < forms.length; i++) {
    var form = forms[i];
    var requestInput = form.querySelector("input[name='web_unit42_req_id']");
    if (requestInput) {
      requestInput.value = requestID;
    }
  }
};


//Adding FR compliance checkbox
var languageFromPage = 'en_US';
(function () {
  console.log("IIFE Loaded: Global Form Pixel Tracking Script");

  // Target countries matching requirements
  var TARGET_COUNTRIES = ['FR', 'IT'];
  window.GEO_LOCATION_FR = false;

  // Mapping full country select option values/texts to 2-letter codes or names
  function isTargetCountryString(str) {
    if (!str) return false;
    var normalized = str.trim().toUpperCase();
    return (
      normalized === 'FR' ||
      normalized === 'FRANCE' ||
      normalized === 'IT' ||
      normalized === 'ITALY'
    );
  }

  // Helper to match target country names
  function isTargetCountryName(country) {
    if (!country) return false;
    var normalized = country.trim().toUpperCase();
    return (
      normalized === 'FRANCE' ||
      normalized === 'ITALY' ||
      normalized === 'FR' ||
      normalized === 'IT'
    );
  }

  // Get country name dynamically based on OneTrust country code
  function getGeoLocationCountryName() {
    if (typeof OneTrust !== 'undefined' && typeof OneTrust.getGeolocationData === 'function') {
      var geoData = OneTrust.getGeolocationData();
      if (geoData && geoData.country) {
        var code = geoData.country.toUpperCase();
        if (code === 'IT') return 'Italy';
        if (code === 'FR') return 'France';
      }
    }
    return '';
  }

  function getLocalizedValue(locale) {
    switch (locale) {
      case 'en_US':
        return "Allow email engagement tracking (opens and clicks) for personalized content.";
      case 'zh_CN':
        return "允许跟踪电子邮件互动情况（打开和点击），以便提供个性化内容。";
      case 'zh_TW':
        return "允許電子郵件互動追蹤 (開啟與點擊) 以提供個人化內容。";
      case 'es_ES':
        return "Permitir el seguimiento de mis interacciones con los correos electrónicos (aperturas y clics) para recibir contenidos personalizados.";
      case 'es_LA':
        return "Permitir el seguimiento de la interacción con los correos electrónicos (aperturas y clics) para ofrecer contenido personalizado.";
      case 'pt_BR':
        return "Permitir o rastreamento do engajamento por e-mail (aberturas e cliques) para conteúdo personalizado.";
      case 'ko_KR':
        return "개인화된 콘텐츠의 이메일 참여 추적(열기 및 클릭)을 허용합니다.";
      case 'fr_FR':
        return "J’autorise le suivi de mes interactions avec les e-mails (ouvertures et clics) afin de recevoir des contenus personnalisés.";
      case 'de_DE':
        return "Gestatten Sie die Erfassung von E-Mail-Interaktionen (Öffnungen und Klicks), um personalisierte Inhalte zu erhalten.";
      case 'it_IT':
        return "Consenti il monitoraggio delle interazioni via e-mail (aperture e clic) per contenuti personalizzati.";
      case 'ja_JP':
        return "コンテンツのパーソナライズのため、メール エンゲージメントの追跡(開封とクリック)を許可。";
      default:
        return "Allow email engagement tracking (opens and clicks) for personalized content.";
    }
  }

  // Evaluate initial GeoLocation state from OneTrust
  function isTargetGeoLocation() {
    if (typeof OneTrust !== 'undefined' && typeof OneTrust.getGeolocationData === 'function') {
      var geoData = OneTrust.getGeolocationData();

      console.log("OneTrust GeoLocation Data:", geoData, "Country:", geoData ? geoData.country : 'N/A');

      if (geoData && geoData.country) {
        var country = geoData.country.toUpperCase();
        if (TARGET_COUNTRIES.indexOf(country) !== -1) {
          window.GEO_LOCATION_FR = true;
          return true;
        }
      }
    }
    window.GEO_LOCATION_FR = false;
    return false;
  }

  // Create the standard checkbox DOM structure based on form theme
  function createCheckboxElement(form) {
    var wrapper;

    // Check if form uses the custom theme format (e.g., Form 3, 4, 5)
    var isCustomTheme = form.querySelector('.captcha-section') || form.querySelector('.checkbox');

    if (isCustomTheme && form.id != 'pan_prisma_microsite_modal_form') {
      wrapper = document.createElement('div');
      wrapper.className = 'form-row email-pixel-wrapper mt-2 mb-2';

      var labelWrapper = document.createElement('label');
      labelWrapper.className = 'checkbox';

      if($(form).hasClass("form_events_vutdProgramme")){
        labelWrapper.className += " subscribe";
      }
      var spanIcon = document.createElement('span');
      spanIcon.className = 'checkbox-icon checkbox';

      var checkbox = document.createElement('input');
      checkbox.type = 'checkbox';
      checkbox.name = 'emailPixelTracking';
      checkbox.id = 'emailPixelTracking_' + Math.random().toString(36).substr(2, 9);
      checkbox.value = 'true';

      var iconInner = document.createElement('span');
      iconInner.className = 'icon d-flex';

      spanIcon.appendChild(checkbox);
      spanIcon.appendChild(iconInner);

      var spanText = document.createElement('span');
      var textClass;
      // Detect light or dark mode styling
      if(form.querySelector('.text-dark') == null){
        textClass = 'label-2 legal display-1';
      }else{
        textClass = form.querySelector('.text-dark') ? 'label-2 text-dark' : 'label-2 text-light';
      }
      if(!$(form).hasClass("form_events_vutdProgramme")){
        spanText.className = textClass;
      }
      spanText.textContent = getLocalizedValue(languageFromPage);

      labelWrapper.appendChild(spanIcon);
      labelWrapper.appendChild(spanText);
      wrapper.appendChild(labelWrapper);
    } else {
      // Standard Bootstrap format (e.g., Form 1, 2)
      wrapper = document.createElement('div');
      wrapper.className = 'form-check checkbox-wrapper mb-2 d-flex align-items-center email-pixel-wrapper';
      if(form.name == "create_user_form" && !$(form).find(".checkbox-container").length){
        wrapper.style = "gap:10px";
      }
      var checkbox = document.createElement('input');
      checkbox.type = 'checkbox';
      checkbox.name = 'emailPixelTracking';
      checkbox.id = 'emailPixelTracking_' + Math.random().toString(36).substr(2, 9);
      checkbox.className = 'form-check-input mb-0';
      checkbox.value = 'true';
      checkbox.style = "width:auto;";
      let $sticyform = $(".sticky-form-html");
      if($sticyform.length){
        $sticyform.find(".checkbox-wrapper").find("input").css("flex","0");
        $sticyform.find(".checkbox-wrapper").find("span").addClass("ml-2");
        checkbox.style += "flex:0;margin-top:0px;";
      }
      var label = document.createElement('span');
      label.htmlFor = checkbox.id;

      // Handle text color based on form layout
      var isWhiteText = form.querySelector('.text-white');
      if(form.name == "bootcamp-registration"){
        wrapper.className = wrapper.className + " col-12 mb-4";
      }
      label.className = 'form-check-label label-3  ' +  (isWhiteText ? 'text-white ' : '') + ' ml-2 mb-0 pb-0';
      label.textContent = getLocalizedValue(languageFromPage);
      if(form.id == "footer_form_manage_subscriptions"){
         label.style = "margin-left:0.75rem";
      }
      wrapper.appendChild(checkbox);
      wrapper.appendChild(label);
    }

    return wrapper;
  }

  var buildDropdown = function(result, dropdown){
    // Remove current options
    dropdown.html('');

    // Check result isn't empty
    if(result && result.length > 0){
        // Loop through each of the results and append the option to the dropdown
        $.each(result, function() {
            dropdown.append('<option value="' + this.value + '">' + this.label + '</option>');
        });
    }
  };

  function dropdownInit(){
    if(window.countryOptions && isTargetGeoLocation()){
      let $country = $('select[name="Country"]');
      if(!$country.length){
        $country = $('select[name="country"]');
      }
      $.each($country, function(index, element) {
        buildDropdown(window.countryOptions, $(element));
      });
    }
  }

  $(document).on('click', '#notyou, [data-cmp-hook="notyou"]', function (e) {
    const $form = $(this).closest('form');

    setTimeout(function () {
      let $countryInput = $form.find('[name="Country"]');
      if(!$countryInput.length){
        $countryInput = $form.find('[name="country"]');
      }
      if(isTargetGeoLocation()){
        injectCheckbox($form.get(0));
      }else{
        removeCheckbox($form.get(0));
        $countryInput.val('');
      }
    }, 110);
  });

  const originalFetch = window.fetch;

  // Override window.fetch
  window.fetch = async function (...args) {
    let [resource, config] = args;

    try {
      const response = await originalFetch.apply(this, [resource, config]);
      if(resource == "/apps/pan/public/filterleads.getLeadDetailsForWebDataLayer.json"){
        const response2 = response.clone();
        const data = await response2.json();
        if (data.success && data.data.Email) {
          var forms = document.querySelectorAll('form');
          forms.forEach(function (form) {
            if(isTargetCountryName(data.data.Country)){
              $(form).find('[name="Country"]').val(data.data.Country);
              injectCheckbox(form);
            }
            else{
              removeCheckbox(form);
            }
          });
        }
      }

      return response;
    } catch (error) {
      throw error;
    }
  };

  $(document).ajaxComplete(function(event, xhr, settings) {
    if (settings.url.includes('/etc/formsconfig/webformsconfig.json') ) {
      if (xhr.status >= 200 && xhr.status < 300) {
          window.countryOptions = xhr.responseJSON.country[languageFromPage || PAN_LOAD_RECAPTCHA_LANGUAGE];
          dropdownInit();
      }
    }
    if (settings.url.includes('/apps/pan/public/filterleads.getLeadDetailsForWebDataLayer.json') ) {
      if (xhr.status >= 200 && xhr.status < 300) {
        if(xhr.responseJSON.success && xhr.responseJSON.data.Email){
          var forms = document.querySelectorAll('form');
          forms.forEach(function (form) {
            if(isTargetCountryName(xhr.responseJSON.data.Country)){
              $(form).find('[name="Country"]').val(xhr.responseJSON.data.Country);
              injectCheckbox(form);
            }
            else{
              removeCheckbox(form);
            }
          });
        }
      }
    }
  });

  $(document).ajaxSend(function(event, jqXHR, settings) {
    if (settings.url.includes('/apps/pan/public/formsubmithandler.submitform.json')) {
      let params = new URLSearchParams(settings.data || '');
      if($('[name="emailPixelTracking"]').length){
        if(params.get("emailPixelTracking") == 'true'){
          params.set('emailPixelTracking', true);
        }
        else{
          params.set('emailPixelTracking', false);
        }
      }
      settings.data = params.toString();
    }
  });

  // Dynamically inject the checkbox inside a form based on structure
  function injectCheckbox(form) {
    if (form.querySelector('input[name="emailPixelTracking"]')) return;

    var checkboxEl = createCheckboxElement(form);

    var captchaSection = form.querySelector('.captcha-section');
    if (captchaSection) {
      var legalInCaptcha = captchaSection.querySelector('.legal');
      if (legalInCaptcha) {
        captchaSection.insertBefore(checkboxEl, legalInCaptcha);
        return;
      }
      captchaSection.insertBefore(checkboxEl, captchaSection.firstChild);
      return;
    }

    var legalContainer = form.querySelectorAll('.form-legal');
    if (legalContainer.length) {
      legalContainer = legalContainer[0];
      let legalparentElement = legalContainer.parentElement;
      if(legalparentElement.classList.contains('form-row')){
        legalparentElement.parentElement.insertBefore(checkboxEl, legalparentElement);
      }
      else{
         legalContainer.insertBefore(checkboxEl, legalContainer.firstChild);
      }
      return;
    }

    var legalContainer = form.querySelectorAll('.legal');
    if (legalContainer.length) {
      legalContainer = legalContainer.length > 2 ? legalContainer[1] : legalContainer[0];
      let legalparentElement = legalContainer.parentElement;
      if(!legalparentElement.classList.contains('terms')){
        if(legalparentElement.classList.contains('form-row')){
          legalparentElement.parentElement.insertBefore(checkboxEl, legalparentElement);
        }
        else{
          legalContainer.insertBefore(checkboxEl, legalContainer.firstChild);
        }
        return;
      }
    }

    var termsSubmit = form.querySelector('.terms-submit');
    if (termsSubmit) {
      termsSubmit.insertBefore(checkboxEl, termsSubmit.firstChild);
      return;
    }

    var terms = form.querySelector('.terms') || form.querySelector('.terms-condition');
    if (terms) {
      if($(terms).hasClass("checkbox-wrapper")){
        terms = $(terms).next().length ?  $(terms).next().get(0) : terms;
      }
      terms.before(checkboxEl);
      return;
    }
    var terms = form.querySelector('.checkbox-container');
    if (terms) {
      $(terms).append(checkboxEl).find(".label-3").removeClass("label-3");
      return;
    }
  }

  // Remove checkbox if country selection changes away from targeted countries
  function removeCheckbox(form) {
    var existingWrapper = form.querySelector('.email-pixel-wrapper');
    if (existingWrapper) {
      existingWrapper.parentNode.removeChild(existingWrapper);
    }
  }

  // Evaluate dynamic state for a specific form
  function evaluateForm(form, isGeoMatch) {
    if (isGeoMatch) {
      injectCheckbox(form);
      var detectedCountry = getGeoLocationCountryName();
      if (detectedCountry && !$(form).find('[name="Country"]').length && !$(form).find('[name="country"]').length) {
        $(form).prepend('<input type="hidden" name="Country" id="Country" value="' + detectedCountry + '"></input>');
      }
      return;
    }

    var countrySelect = form.querySelector('select[name="Country"]') || form.querySelector('select[name="country"]');
    if (countrySelect) {
      var selectedValue = countrySelect.value;
      var selectedText = countrySelect.options[countrySelect.selectedIndex]
        ? countrySelect.options[countrySelect.selectedIndex].text
        : '';

      if (isTargetCountryString(selectedValue) || isTargetCountryString(selectedText)) {
        injectCheckbox(form);
      } else {
        removeCheckbox(form);
      }
    }
  }

  // Attach change listener to country dropdowns
  function bindCountrySelectListeners(isGeoMatch) {
    var countrySelects = document.querySelectorAll('select[name="Country"]');
    if(!countrySelects.length){
      countrySelects = document.querySelectorAll('select[name="country"]');
    }
    countrySelects.forEach(function (select) {
      if (select.dataset.pixelListenerAttached) return;

      select.addEventListener('change', function (e) {
        var form = select.closest('form');
        if (form && !isGeoMatch) {
          evaluateForm(form, isGeoMatch);
        } else if(!isTargetCountryName(e.target.value) && isGeoMatch) {
          removeCheckbox(form);
        } else if(isTargetCountryName(e.target.value)) {
          injectCheckbox(form);
        }
      });
      select.dataset.pixelListenerAttached = "true";
    });
  }

  // Main evaluation function across all forms
  function processAllForms() {
    var isGeoMatch = isTargetGeoLocation();
    var forms = document.querySelectorAll('form');
    if(isGeoMatch){
      dropdownInit();
    }

    forms.forEach(function (form) {
      evaluateForm(form, isGeoMatch);
    });

    bindCountrySelectListeners(isGeoMatch);
  }

  // --- Integrations & Hooks ---

  // 1. OneTrust OptanonWrapper Hook
  var originalOptanonWrapper = window.OptanonWrapper;
  window.OptanonWrapper = function () {
    if (typeof originalOptanonWrapper === 'function') {
      originalOptanonWrapper();
    }
    processAllForms();
  };

  // 2. OneTrust Live Consent Updates Listener
  window.addEventListener('OneTrustGroupsUpdated', function () {
    processAllForms();
  });

  // 3. Document Ready Execution
  if (document.readyState === 'interactive' || document.readyState === 'complete') {
    processAllForms();
  } else {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', processAllForms);
  }
  processAllForms();
})();
</script>
